⚠️ One-time Supabase setup chahiye
IDs ko sab devices par chalane ke liye Supabase me ek chhoti table banani hai. Supabase → SQL Editor kholo, ye SQL paste karke Run dabao, phir page refresh karo.
create table if not exists public.app_users (
  uname text primary key,
  data  jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb
);
alter table public.app_users enable row level security;
drop policy if exists "app_users_all" on public.app_users;
create policy "app_users_all" on public.app_users
  for all to anon using (true) with check (true);
